units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 11:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XI, 3</cite> <he>אם הצדיקים שהשתיתו … ופִיגְּרוּ אותם וכ׳</he> when the wicked come and destroy the righteous that have established thy world &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 653:3">Yalk. ib. 653</cite> <he>אם השיתין … עמדו רשעים ופִגְּרוּם וכ׳</he> if the wicked have risen and destroyed the foundations (of the Temple) which face the deep (v. <cite ref="U01103"><he>שִׁית</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 79:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIX</cite> <he>ופיגרו את בניך</he> (ed. Bub. <he>והרגו</he>).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 10:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. X</cite> <he>והצדיקים … ופגרו אותן</he> and the righteous in whom thou didst find pleasure, the enemies haven risen and destroyed them; a. e.
